assets.resources: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game environment background, not UI mockup. Reference is the existing TankStorm base: match its elevated isometric three-quarter camera, realistic miniature military buildings, olive concrete and steel, warm daylight from upper left, conifer and rocky terrain, connected paved roads and fences. Landscape 3:2 composition, no text, no numbers, no labels, no interface, no watermarks. Crisp readable building silhouettes separated by roads and yards; no foreground obstruction; camera orthographic-like, no horizon. Main building clusters between x15%-85%, y20%-78%. Create a new resource district adjacent to that base. SIX distinct separated interactive facilities at exact rough centers: top left (23%,30%) iron blast furnace glowing orange with ore piles; top right (71%,27%) titanium mine with pale silver quarry and compact processing shed; middle left (23%,55%) oil refinery with cylindrical tanks; middle right (76%,52%) lead mine with dark grey ore conveyors and smelter; bottom left (28%,78%) crystal extraction station with blue mineral containers (industrial, not fantasy); bottom right (69%,77%) large military warehouse with olive gabled roof and cargo crates. Each one recognisable as a coherent building site with vacant road in front suitable for a small label. Access road exits bottom center to main base.
